requirements.requirement: Exact signed 64-bit dot product of low 16-bit samples; upper bits ignored
requirements.scope: MAX_LENGTH=256 and 16; seeded Python oracle and both result words
requirements.coverage: Every length in each configuration; signed edges, noisy upper bits and aliased-source wide sum

requirements.requirement: Independent AW/W, byte strobes and retained AXI4-Lite responses
requirements.scope: Single buffered write/read response; synchronous reset
requirements.coverage: Directed AW-first/W-first, masks, response stalls, readback and read-only access rejection

requirements.requirement: Invalid descriptors are rejected before DMA traffic
requirements.scope: Trusted fixed DMA window; no CPU PMP inheritance or whole-SoC isolation claim
requirements.coverage: Zero/excess length, alignment, lower/upper range, wrap and destination overlap with transaction-count checks

requirements.requirement: Read/write errors terminate with ERROR rather than DONE
requirements.scope: Single-beat compliant target; partial writes are not rolled back
requirements.coverage: Injected first-read and second-write errors; status/error code checked

requirements.requirement: Coordinated reset clears protocol state and allows restart
requirements.scope: All fixture participants reset together; memory persists
requirements.coverage: Directed mid-job reset and polling restart, not independently reset domain recovery

requirements.requirement: Support smaller legal maximum length without changing the interface
requirements.scope: Same DMA window, MAX_LENGTH=16
requirements.coverage: Every length 1..16 and excessive length rejection

requirements.requirement: AHB adapter captures data phase and reports two-cycle errors
requirements.scope: Aligned word accesses, AHB-Lite control adapter
requirements.coverage: Poisoned address-phase data, register readback, illegal accesses and recovery

markers: PASS AHB bridge: following data phase, reads, two-cycle errors and recovery

requirements.requirement: Retained payloads, descriptor stability, bounded DMA range and DONE ordering
requirements.scope: Control MAX_LENGTH=16 bound=20; engine valid fixed N=1 bound=24; initial reset and zero initialization
requirements.coverage: Bounded assertions plus an engine DONE witness; no full-control reachability or unbounded claim

markers: PASS bounded engine checks: 24 cycles; reachable DONE witness saved
